references.text: Parallel text where Moses is commanded to take the second ram, the ram of ordination, and Aaron and his sons are to lay their hands on the ram's head.
Describes the ram of ordination and its parts that are to be used in the ordination ceremony for the priests.
Describes the laying on of hands on the head of the sacrifice as part of the sacrificial rituals, the same action performed here.
Refers to the laying on of hands on the head of the sacrifice at the peace offering, the same ritual action.
Laying on of hands on the head of the sin offering, the same ritual pattern as with the ram of ordination.
Earlier in the same chapter where Aaron and his sons lay their hands on the bull for the sin offering, the same ritual action.
Laying on of hands on the burnt offering ram, the first sacrifice before the ram of ordination in the same ceremony.
The Levites are ordained and the Israelites lay their hands on them, parallel to the laying on of hands at ordination.
Hebrews describes how the priests were ordained and points forward to Christ as the perfect high priest.
